root_rule: Replay the official gold prefix through its first pour action, inclusive; no root search.
candidate_rule: Replace the first poured primary-paint name by each of the other two primary names in the same command, plus mix the same destination; lexical sort; exactly three actions.
continuation_rule: After the candidate: mix the same destination; look around; focus on the original task target. Fixed for all candidates and arms, stopping only on native done.
forecast: Actual first-step textual observation only. No score, continuation outcome, hidden state, or gold labels are shown to the actor.
actor: Native WorldEvolver WMReactAgent prompt and parser with a declared three-action restriction and one-generation cap. This is a controlled adapter, not a complete native task reproduction.
prepare_gates: Both fixed roots reproduce exactly including the complete object tree.
All three candidates parse and execute without parser/ambiguity errors.
At each root at least one candidate reaches native score 100 and at least one reaches a lower score under the fixed continuation.
No root/candidate replacement after observing results.
primary_estimand: Native task score and success after the selected action plus the same fixed continuation, Q_fixed_continuation; not complete autonomous agent performance or irrecoverable harm.
signal_rule: A draft_only_truth loss relative to both the root's draft and sham, with all_candidate_truth score at least max(draft score, sham score), qualifies only for independent follow-up. Two fixed development roots do not support significance, ASR, or a general security claim.
pre_api_revision: Independent static review made recovery relative to both draft and sham explicit; no API calls had occurred. Preserve the original failed preparation protocol and launched script.
limitations: Perfect forecast is an environment-oracle diagnostic, not evidence about a pretrained WM's predictive capability.
All-candidate truth exposes more text/information; this screening comparison alone cannot identify coverage independently of information volume.
Variations 0 and 1 share the green-paint task and are not independent task families.
No online learning, memory poisoning, attacker intervention or safety certification claim.
The task is simple; no favorable root, seed, task or candidate search is permitted after a null result.

runtime_revision.change: Use the existing vendor JAR via native serverPath; installed Python wrapper remains ScienceWorld 1.2.3. No engine patch, state normalization, root, candidate, or score change.
runtime_revision.evidence: Installed JAR EnvObject.tick contains no sortBy; vendor JAR tick has two sortBy calls for contained objects and portals. Native serverPath vendor-runtime replay produced exact full-root equality in two variation-0 replays (18 explicit controls).
runtime_revision.interpretation: Runtime reproducibility correction, not a scientific mechanism or security result. Original failed records preserved.
